text: China's November retail sales, industrial output, and fixed-asset investment underperformed forecasts. Property investment contraction deepened; home price declines widened. Consumption remained weak despite extended promotions. Growth stability relied on export surplus amid limited domestic stimulus deployment.

meta.note: Single data-release cluster aggregates multiple indicators under one exposure event.

text: Hong Kong court convicted Jimmy Lai under the national security law for sedition and foreign collusion. The verdict concluded a multi-year prosecution. The judgment coincided with dissolution of remaining pro-democracy structures and followed electoral system restrictions, prompting investor confidence concerns.

meta.note: Sentencing pending; outcome finalized but penalty magnitude unresolved.

text: Ford announced $19.5B in special charges tied to EV write-downs and restructuring. The company reduced pure-EV commitments, canceled large EV trucks, and redirected capital toward hybrids, EREVs, core vehicles, and energy storage, while maintaining adjusted EBIT guidance.

meta.note: Charges excluded from adjusted earnings; cash timing extends through 2027.

text: Frontier replaced CEO Barry Biffle with President James Dempsey as interim CEO. Biffle remains in an advisory role through year-end. The change followed sustained losses, stalled merger talks with Spirit, and sectorwide pressure on low-cost carriers.

meta.note: Interim designation limits resolution; advisory role preserves continuity.

text: President Trump filed a $5B defamation lawsuit against the BBC over a Panorama documentary edit. The broadcaster issued prior apologies, withdrew the program, and saw senior resignations. The filing adds legal constraint amid intensified scrutiny of editorial controls.

meta.note: Civil action initiated; no judicial outcome yet.
